sources.title: thinkingmachines/Inkling-NVFP4 - lambda.ai
sources.snippet: Inkling is the first openly released foundation model from Thinking Machines Lab. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts decoder that is natively multimodal, mapping text and images along with video and audio into a single shared representation processed by the same trunk, with no separate vision or speech encoders bolted on.
